parameters.code: var original = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene(); if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(original.path)) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Expected original untitled scene."); var ids = original.GetRootGameObjects().Select(o => o.GetInstanceID()).ToArray(); var backup = "Assets/ChooGuard/Scenes/SessionBackup-" + System.DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".unity"; System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory("Assets/ChooGuard/Scenes"); if (System.IO.File.Exists(backup)) throw new System.IO.IOException("Backup path exists."); if (!UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(original, backup)) throw new System.IO.IOException("Original scene backup failed."); ChooGuard.Editor.MvpWorkspaceBuilder.Build(); return new { backup, originalRootsBefore=ids, originalRootsAfter=original.GetRootGameObjects().Select(o=>o.GetInstanceID()).ToArray(), sceneCount=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.sceneCount, mvpPath=ChooGuard.Editor.MvpWorkspaceBuilder.ScenePath };
